programs.name: suamp
programs.purpose: Extract amplitude, log amplitude, phase, unwrapped phase, real part, or imaginary part from complex traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUAMP - output amp, phase, real or imag trace from

params.name: mode
params.description: Output component: amp, logamp, phase, ouphase, suphase, real, or imag.

params.name: jack
params.description: Halve the zero-frequency amplitude; also applied to the first sample in logamp mode.

params.name: unwrap
params.description: Phase-unwrapping threshold divisor; read only for unwrapped phase modes, and zero disables unwrapping.

params.name: trend
params.description: Remove the linear phase trend in unwrapped phase modes.

params.name: zeromean
params.description: Use zero-mean phase instead of phase starting at zero in unwrapped phase modes.

params.name: smooth
params.description: Smooth unwrapped phase using damped least squares.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print the missing sampling interval warning.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses sqrt, log and atan2, phase-unwrapping routines and optional least-squares smoothing. The fallback frequency step is calculated as dt/nf. In logamp mode the first output sample is amplitude, not its logarithm.
programs.difficulty_reason: Complex component extraction includes two phase-unwrapping methods and optional smoothing.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sufft verbose=0 | suamp mode=amp jack=1
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sufft verbose=0 | suamp mode=suphase unwrap=0.8 trend=0 zeromean=1 smooth=1 r=5
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sufft verbose=0 | suamp mode=ouphase trend=1
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sufft verbose=0 | suamp mode=logamp

programs.name: suanalytic
programs.purpose: Create a complex analytic trace from each input trace and its Hilbert transform.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUANALYTIC - use the Hilbert transform to generate an ANALYTIC

params.name: phaserot
params.description: If explicitly supplied, multiply the real and Hilbert components by cosine and sine of this angle in degrees; omission follows a different path.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The direct Hilbert transform accumulates floating-point values; an explicitly supplied phaserot uses double-precision trigonometric functions. Explicit phaserot=0 differs from omitting it.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program applies a library Hilbert transform and interleaves two trace components.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suanalytic
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suanalytic phaserot=45

programs.name: succepstrum
programs.purpose: Compute a complex cepstrum using a Fourier transform and unwrapped spectral phase.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCCEPSTRUM - Compute the complex CEPSTRUM of a seismic trace

params.name: mode
params.description: Phase unwrapping method: ouphase or suphase.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT scaling, atan2, logarithms and phase unwrapping are sensitive to rounding. The code writes 2*(nfftc/2+1) values but leaves tr.ns at its input value; it also calls pfacc with nf, which may not be a valid PFA length.
programs.difficulty_reason: The transform combines FFTs, complex logarithms and selectable phase unwrapping.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | succepstrum

test_cases.description: Simple phase unwrapping and opposite transform signs
test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | succepstrum mode=suphase unwrap=0.8 trend=0 zeromean=1 sign1=-1 sign2=1

programs.license_note: Based on sucepstrum by Balazs Nemeth of Potash Corporation of Saskatchewan Inc., given to CWP in 2008.

programs.name: succwt
programs.purpose: Compute a complex continuous wavelet transform or Fourier-kernel decomposition of each trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCCWT - Complex continuous wavelet transform of seismic traces

params.name: k
params.description: Kernel: 1 Morlet, 2 Fourier; invalid values become 1.

params.name: df
params.description: Used to calculate the number of scales when fs=2; scale construction itself does not use df.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses FFTs, complex exponentials, pow and exp with mixed precision. Both kernel builders write w[1] through w[nt], leaving w[0] uninitialized and writing past the allocation; the basis shift can also index beyond the buffer. Verbose output reads a[na] out of bounds.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program builds complex wavelet bases and applies FFT-based convolution over many scales.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | succwt noct=2 nv=3 dt=0.004 fmax=100
suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | succwt fs=2 k=2 dt=0.004 fmax=20 df=5 p=0

programs.license_note: Also copyrighted University of Tulsa, 2003-4; authors Chris Liner and Bob Clapp.

programs.name: sucepstrum
programs.purpose: Convert real traces to real cepstral traces using a complex log spectrum.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCEPSTRUM - transform to the CEPSTRal domain

params.name: sign1
params.description: Forward FFT sign, restricted to 1 or -1.

params.name: sign2
params.description: Inverse FFT sign, restricted to 1 or -1.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: seismic tr.dt/1000000 or nonseismic tr.d1, falling back to 0.004
params.description: Documented but never read as a parameter; sampling interval is taken from the header.

params.name: mode
params.description: Phase unwrapping method: ouphase or suphase.

params.name: unwrap
params.description: Threshold divisor for simple unwrapping; zero disables either unwrapping method.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT rounding, log, atan2, phase unwrapping and optional smoothing affect results; sampling interval and scaling mix float and double arithmetic.
programs.difficulty_reason: The implementation combines forward and inverse FFTs with phase unwrapping and optional smoothing.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sucepstrum verbose=0
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sucepstrum verbose=0 mode=suphase unwrap=0.8 trend=0 zeromean=1 smooth=1 r=5

test_cases.description: No phase unwrapping and reversed signs
test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sucepstrum verbose=0 unwrap=0 sign1=-1 sign2=1

programs.name: suclogfft
programs.purpose: Transform real traces into complex logarithmic frequency spectra.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCLOGFFT - fft real time traces to complex log frequency domain traces

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: seismic tr.dt/1000000 or nonseismic tr.d1, falling back to 0.004
params.description: Documented but never read as a parameter.

params.name: mode
params.description: Phase unwrapping method: ouphase or suphase; the selfdoc incorrectly lists suphase as default.

params.name: unwrap
params.description: Simple unwrapping threshold divisor; zero disables either method.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT, log, atan2 and phase-unwrapping rounding affect output; near-zero amplitudes are handled by CLOSETO.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines a padded FFT with logarithmic amplitude and selectable phase unwrapping.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suclogfft verbose=0 mode=ouphase
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suclogfft verbose=0 mode=suphase unwrap=0.8 trend=0 zeromean=1 sign=-1
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suclogfft verbose=0 unwrap=0

programs.name: sucwt
programs.purpose: Compute wavelet amplitude panels or a Holder regularity estimate for each input trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCWT - generates Continous Wavelet Transform amplitude, regularity

params.name: xmin
params.description: Minimum wavelet coordinate; overwritten with 0.0 when xcenter is omitted.

params.name: xcenter
params.description: Wavelet center; when omitted, a coding error assigns 0.0 to xmin instead.

params.name: holder
params.description: Output Holder regularity instead of amplitude panels.

params.name: divisor
params.description: Controls regression segment lengths for Holder estimates.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Wavelet and scale construction use pow, exp and mixed float/double arithmetic; convolution and regression depend on accumulation order. Filter indexing can exceed allocations for some scale settings; Holder mode has an unassigned output when icount equals 10 and can loop indefinitely when the integer increment derived from interval is zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program constructs many filters, performs convolution and Hilbert transforms, and optionally fits regressions.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | sucwt nwavelet=128 xmin=-5 xcenter=0 xmax=5 first=-1 last=0 expinc=0.2
suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | sucwt holder=1 divisor=1 nwavelet=256 xmin=-5 xcenter=0 xmax=5 first=-1 last=0 expinc=0.05

programs.license_note: Credits say the implementation was inspired in part by BHP_SU bhpcwt, written by Michael Glinsky, based loosely on a Matlab CWT function.

programs.name: sufft
programs.purpose: Transform real traces into complex frequency-domain traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFFT - fft real time traces to complex frequency traces

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: seismic tr.dt/1000000 or nonseismic tr.d1, falling back to 0.004
params.description: Documented but never read as a parameter.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: PFA FFT arithmetic and float/double sampling-interval calculations affect exact output bits.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program pads traces and performs a real-to-complex FFT.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | sufft verbose=0
suplane nt=128 ntr=4 | sufft sign=-1 verbose=0

programs.name: sugabor
programs.purpose: Produce time-frequency amplitude panels or regularity estimates using Gaussian frequency filters.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGABOR -  Outputs a time-frequency representation of seismic data via

params.name: dt
params.description: Time sampling interval; required if the header value is zero, and the resulting value must be nonzero.

params.name: fmax
params.description: Upper frequency used to determine filter count.

params.name: holder
params.description: 0 outputs amplitude panels; 1 or 2 outputs logarithmic or linear regularity estimates.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT, Hilbert transform, exp, sqrt, log and regression are sensitive to rounding and accumulation order. Holder mode reads tmpdata[j][i+1] beyond the last populated filter column, and requires enough filters for y[3].
programs.difficulty_reason: The program filters FFTs at multiple frequencies and optionally performs per-sample regression.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | sugabor dt=0.004 fmin=5 fmax=65 band=10 beta=3
suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | sugabor dt=0.004 fmin=0 fmax=80 band=10 holder=2 alpha=0.03

programs.name: suhilb
programs.purpose: Apply a direct time-domain Hilbert transform to each trace.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The Hilbert transform's floating-point accumulation order affects exact results.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program applies a library Hilbert transform independently to each trace.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suhilb
suplane nt=128 ntr=4 | suhilb

programs.name: suicepstrum
programs.purpose: Attempt to reconstruct real traces from real cepstral traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUICEPSTRUM - fft of complex log frequency traces to real time traces

params.name: sign1
params.description: Forward FFT sign, restricted to 1 or -1.

params.name: sign2
params.description: Inverse FFT sign, restricted to 1 or -1.

params.name: sym
params.description: Center output by changing alternate frequency signs.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: tr.dt/1000000, then tr.d1 if zero, then 0.004 if still zero

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses FFTs, exp, sin and cos with mixed float/double arithmetic. The inverse pfacr is called with newnf rather than newnfft, potentially an invalid transform length, leaving part of the zeroed output untouched. A zero real spectral component is mapped to zero instead of exp(0).
programs.difficulty_reason: The inverse cepstral calculation uses forward and inverse FFTs and complex exponentiation.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | sucepstrum verbose=0 unwrap=0 | suicepstrum dt=0.004
suspike nt=128 ntr=1 | sucepstrum verbose=0 | suicepstrum dt=0.004 sym=1 sign1=-1 sign2=1 verbose=1

programs.name: suiclogfft
programs.purpose: Convert complex logarithmic spectra back to real traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUICLOGFFT - fft of complex log frequency traces to real time traces

params.name: sign
params.description: Inverse FFT sign, restricted to 1 or -1.

params.name: sym
params.description: Center the output by changing alternate frequency signs.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Complex exponentiation uses exp, cos and sin with mixed float/double arithmetic, followed by an FFT and scaling. A zero log-amplitude is mapped to zero rather than exp(0).
programs.difficulty_reason: The program exponentiates a complex spectrum and applies an inverse FFT.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suclogfft verbose=0 unwrap=0 | suiclogfft
suspike nt=128 ntr=2 | suclogfft verbose=0 sign=-1 | suiclogfft sign=1 sym=1
